clips.title: The story
paras: Hardened Tortoise Shells are remarkably durable carapaces harvested from the sparkleshell tortoises wandering the Shimmering Flats. Coveted by gnomish racers at the Mirage Raceway, these rugged organic plates offer unmatched resistance against volatile and corrosive experimental fuels.

The sun-scorched expanse of the Shimmering Flats is home to various breeds of sparkleshell tortoises, including snappers and borers, whose carapaces have evolved into exceptionally tough defenses against the harsh desert salt and wandering predators. Out on the salt flats, standard metal alloy fuel tanks frequently corrode or rupture under the strain of gnomish experimental chemistry. Mechanics like Wizzle Brassbolts prize these shells not for armor or shields, but as organic raw material tough enough to be retrofitted into makeshift, acid-resistant fuel tanks capable of containing volatile rocket propellants.
